description: You are a maintenance electrician at a manufacturing plant preparing to rewire a 3-phase motor bank. The existing supply is 415 V line-to-line. The motor bank currently draws 63 amperes of line current. Before rewiring, you need to document the electrical parameters for the engineering record: (1) What phase voltage will each motor winding receive if the bank is connected in wye (star) configuration? (2) What phase current flows through each winding if the bank is connected in delta configuration (at the same 63 A line current)? Use the conversion calculators in this app to determine both values. The distinction between line and phase quantities is critical for correct motor winding selection.
